application.label: Hydra NLP Pipeline
application.desc: Hydra is the unified processing back-end for linguistic analysis. Hydra is a state-of-the-art Polish NLP model that integrates morphological analysis, dependency parsing, and named entity recognition in a single processing pipeline.
